mask_encoding: row runs [y,x,length], absolute sheet pixel coordinates
scalpDefinition: Anatomical crown under hair, x=21..39 plus source head dx, y=5..17; opaque face underpainting covers this mask. Ear, cheek, forehead below the hairline are not scalp. Mask must be rechecked when adding another direction or moving the hairline.

production.method: One image-edit design study from the enlarged g3 reference; variants traced manually onto the original 64 px grid using only existing source colors. Original pixels extracted without scaling; hidden face fill is occluded in the all-1 composite.
production.headMotion: Same per-frame head coordinates baked into each layer. Original walking head drifts +1 px x on walk frame 5; y remains fixed. Tail has no secondary motion in this trial.

previews.walkTiming: Static six-frame strip; no runtime timing change proposed.

notes: P2 is a review-only partial delivery, not a complete 8-direction paperdoll. All 1–7 direction slots are intentionally unavailable, not missing-file fallbacks.
Back-facing eyes/mouth rule, all-hair coverage over 14 frames and the full all-1 baseline over 14 frames remain untested pending P2 approval.
Color regions are disjoint within a file. Different files intentionally overlap because this is layered artwork. Fixed outlines, sclera, shirt, leather and ribbons keep their original source colors.
A narrow original braid ribbon was moved into hairback-1 so it disappears when selecting short hair; composite all-1 remains unchanged.

Head motion evidence uses vertical centers of bounding boxes over six walk frames plus the shared per-frame head anchors; changing hair silhouettes may change absolute centers but not their frame-to-frame displacement.
